text:
Kira: taking over for this shift — quick context: we got a pager storm for embeddings-east about 15m ago, latency jumped and a few downstream jobs started timing out. tagging @Sam as secondary. :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: [ALERT] pager triggered — embeddings-east latency > 800ms for 5m, error rate increased to 2.1% — incident id INC-7892 — https://incidents.example/INC-7892

Sam: on it, joining bridge. anyone seen an obvious config drift?

Alex: I looked at recent deploys, nothing to embeddings service in last 6h. but noticed autoscaler for embeddings-east dropped capacity earlier due to transient OOMs on node pool gpua2.

Maya: I saw that — kube events showed `Evicted` on 3 pods, autoscaler scaled down then back up. possible noisy host.

Kira: good catch. mitigation plan: 1) move high-priority customer traffic to embeddings-west via routing override, 2) drain suspect nodes, 3) bump reserved capacity for embeddings-east until we stabilize.

Alex: can we do a quick routing override? I have the CLI snippet: ```
redwood route update --service embeddings --region east --fallback-region west --weight 0.7
```

Sam: executing now. will keep weight small so we don't overwhelm west.

ops-bot: command accepted — starting phased reroute from embeddings-east -> embeddings-west (target 30% shift)

Kira: checking impacts — product sheet shows 3 customers affected: AcmeCorp (high qps), FastSearch (medium), internal-evals (low). I'll open a customer impact note.

Jo-Product: pls add a brief line for support w/ suggested customer message — "We're routing to a healthy region to reduce latency; no data loss expected."

Kira: noted. filing the customer note and ticket: INC-7892/8751 for postmortem and action items.

Sam: while reroute is rolling, I'm sshing into the affected node pool. logs show kernel OOM kills on a specific GPU driver process. snippet: ```
[2026-03-15T03:12:21Z] gpu_driver: killed process 4242 (inference_worker)
[2026-03-15T03:12:21Z] kubelet: Pod embeddings-xyz evicted: OOMKilled
```

Alex: that maps to this host id g-east-12. I'm cordoning and draining it: `kubectl drain g-east-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

Maya: I'll also spin a replacement node with a slightly larger root volume — might be a transient log-space issue.

oncall-bot: user Sam assigned as responder for INC-7892 — priority P2 — ETA to update 15m

Kira: running through runbook snippet (embeddings-region-latency.md): ```
1) check autoscaler metrics: /dash/autoscale/embeddings-east
2) check node events: kubectl get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=g-east-12
3) rotate traffic: redwood route update ...
4) if kernel OOM persists, escalate to infra oncall and consider rebooting host
```

Sam: autoscaler shows oscillation around threshold, likely due to OOM spikes. after draining g-east-12 the pod distribution improved. latency down to ~320ms from 820ms for majority traffic.

Kira: nice — keep monitoring. Sam, can you file the infra ticket for driver investigation (TICKET-4520)? I'll add it to the incident summary.

Sam: filed TICKET-4520 with logs and host metadata. linking to INC-7892.

Maya: reroute completed, we sustained 30% to west for 10m, no errors observed in west. fallback policy ready if needed. :thumbsup:

Kira: ok handoff notes for next shift: primary = Kira until 04:00 UTC, secondary = Sam, escalation to Alex for infra driver/kernel, runbook location: https://playbooks.internal/embeddings-region-latency. key action items: 1) infra to root-cause GPU driver OOMs (TICKET-4520), 2) ops to review autoscaler thresholds and pod memory limits (INC-7892-OPS), 3) schedule a 30m retro tomorrow 15:00 UTC (calendar link) — owner Maya.

Jo-Product: flagged customer comms draft in Zendesk, cc'ing support.

Alex: I'll follow up on capacity bump/discount for Dedicated customers affected.

Kira: final check — latency holding ~300-350ms, error rate <0.3%. I'm going offline for handoff now. Sam, you're primary until I return or until 04:00 UTC. please escalate to Alex for infra urgent stuff.

Sam: ack — taking primary. I'll keep the bridge open for at least 30m and post updates here.

oncall-bot: handoff recorded — primary: Sam, secondary: Alex, incident: INC-7892, handoff_ts: 2412345600

Maya: leaving the bridge but I'll monitor logs for the next hour. if anything spikes I'll ping here. good luck! :coffee:
